test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 74

questions.question: Which number from the following is divisible by 15?

The radius of the base of a conical vessel is 9 cm and its height is 64 cm. This vessel is full of water. This water is poured into a cylindrical vessel having base radius of 12 cm. The depth of the water in the cylindrical  vessel is:
The houses of two friends are 2.8 km apart. They started from their homes to meet each other with speeds of 3.8 km/h and 4.6 km/h. How many minutes will they take to meet?
In a 700 m race, the ratio of the speeds of two participants A and B was 6 : 7. If A had a head start of 220 m over B, then by what distance did A win the race?
A man, who can finish a task in 20 days, works for 5 days. Then he is joined by a woman and the remaining task is finished in 9 days. The woman alone can finish the whole task in _____ days.

The marked price of 60 items is equal to the cost price of 96 items. If the profit percentage from the sale of each item is 2.4%, and the selling price of 50 items is equal to the marked price of y items, then what is the value of y?
What is the smallest number of 5 digits that is completely divisible by 13?
At what rate (in percentage) per year will a sum of money double itself in 5 years on simple interest?
If x : y = 5 : 4 and y : z = 3 : 2, then the value of (x − y) : (y − z) is:
Two numbers have a highest common factor of 18 and a least common multiple of 540. If one of the numbers is 90, find the other number.
A class of 30 students appeared in a test. The average score of 12 students is 80 and that of the rest is 75. What is the average score of the class?
A man goes from place A to B at a speed of 18 km/hr and returns from B to A at a speed of 30 km/hr using the same route. The average speed for the whole journey is:
A TV set is sold for ₹6,800 at a loss of 15%. Find the ideal selling price of it, in order to gain 12%.
The average of 13 numbers is 7. If each number is multiplied by 9, then what will be the new average?

A solid cuboid having dimensions of 18 cm ⨯ 12 cm ⨯ 8 cm and a solid cube having the same volume as that of the given cuboid are made with the help of paper sheets. What will be the cost of the sheet required to make the cube if it costs ₹50 per cm2?
If the volume of a right circular cone of height 15 cm is 180π cm3, find the diameter of its base.

The first science fair of a season was attended by 750 students, while the second fair saw an attendance of 1100 students. Calculate the percentage increase in attendance at the second fair compared to the first, rounding your answer to two decimal places.
A boat takes 4 hours to travel a distance of 48 km downstream and 6 hours to travel the same distance upstream. Find the speed of the boat in still water.
The sides of a triangle are 85 cm, 13 cm, and 84 cm. What is its area (in cm2)?
The ratio of the speeds of two trucks is 5 : 3. The time taken by the faster truck to cover a distance of 120 km is 2 hours less than the other. Find the speed of the slower truck.
